caption: The drawing features two objects rendered on a plain, off-white background. The upper object is a small, shallow cup with a handle, colored in pale yellow and beige tones, and has a round perforated bottom. The handle extends to the right and has a subtle twisted texture. The larger object, positioned diagonally across the page below the cup, is a ladle with a long, ornately twisted handle ending in a loop or ring on the left. The ladle's bowl is shown in a brownish-bronze color with evident shading and highlights for a metallic effect and appears divided into several curved segments. Both objects are illustrated with attention to detail, and the name "Stanley Mazur" is written below the ladle in small text.
title: Starch Strainer
